$comment: How each category of the model looks in every medium, in the schema's order: its default Lucide icon, Archify's type for it, whether its parts lie outside the described system, and whether it takes the palette's accent role; then the category of a part that names no kind, and a group's look. The model's schema states the categories and the default one; src/kinds.mjs reads this table, tools/docs/references.mjs writes the model reference's table of categories from it and the schema, and tests/category-looks.test.mjs holds its categories to the schema's and its kindless category to the schema's default.
